attempts.summary: Deployed inventory-worker as an OpenRC-managed service on node1 (Alpine) via an Ansible playbook run from node2 (the ansible-controller/control_node). The service runs a long-running loop that appends heartbeats to /var/lib/inventory/worker.log, confined by a private mount namespace (root filesystem bind-remounted read-only, /var/lib/inventory bind-remounted read-write) combined with setpriv dropping to the unprivileged `inventory` user, clearing the capability bounding set/inheritable/ambient caps, and setting no-new-privs. Verified writes succeed only inside /var/lib/inventory and fail everywhere else, NoNewPrivs=1 and CapEff=0 for the running process, service is enabled at the default OpenRC runlevel, and a full Ansible re-run is idempotent (0 changed). Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol on both node1 and node2: captured boot_id baselines, issued native `reboot`, polled until exec access returned, and confirmed changed boot_id plus full recovery (service auto-restarted with confinement intact on node1; Ansible control/SSH functionality restored on node2, followed by a clean idempotent playbook re-run).
